basic_info.description: 33-35 Hemway Terrace is a charming duplex located in San Francisco's desirable Lone Mountain neighborhood. The building includes an updated 4-bedroom, 2-bath lower unit, a 2-bedroom, 1-bath  upper unit, and an additional bonus unit. All units are currently tenant-occupied, providing steady  rental income. The property also features a spacious backyard and a 2-car garage, offering added convenience for residents. With all units leased, this versatile building presents a strong investment  opportunity in one of San Francisco's most sought-after areas.
